ACT IV OF 2016
ACT IV OF 2016
FEDERAL JUDICIAL ACADEMY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An
Act further to amend the Federal Judicial Act, 1997
[Gazette
of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd February, 2016]
No. F. 22(9)/2014-Legis, dated 29-1-2016.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the
President on the 29th January, 2016 and is hereby published for general
information:
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Federal Judicial
Academy Act, 1997 (XXVIII of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Federal
Judicial Academy
(Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once

Amendment of section 5, Act XXVIII of 1997

No. F. 22(9)/2014-Legis, dated 29-1-2016.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the
President on the 29th January, 2016 and is hereby published for general
information:
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Federal Judicial
Academy Act, 1997 (XXVIII of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:
2. Amendment of section 5, Act XXVIII of 1997.---In the Federal Judicial
Academy Act, 1997 (XXVIII of 1997), in section 5, in subsection (1), after
clause (vii), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:
"(viia) The Chief Justice of
Islamabad High Court Member.".
